name: prerequisite_repair
persona: A learner whose dependent concept is blocked by a missing prerequisite.
description: Exercises prerequisite repair before returning to pointer dereferencing.

turns.content: If p is an int pointer, what does *p mean?
It is the pointer's name; I do not understand what an address represents.
An address identifies a memory location where a value can be stored.
Then *p accesses the int stored at the memory address held in p.

rubric: the address prerequisite stays active until repaired
the tutor verifies the prerequisite before resuming dereferencing
the dependent concept resumes only after sufficient prerequisite evidence
turn_rubrics: identify the memory-address prerequisite and keep it active
verify the repaired address concept before resuming dereferencing
respond to the dependent dereferencing explanation only after prerequisite repair
